_comment: Simplified Chinese UI dictionary for site/i18n.js. Sections: strings (UI text, English -> 简体中文), data (text that comes from data files such as build titles and summaries in data/build-library.json; add new entries here in the same English -> Chinese form), patterns ([regex, replacement] pairs for text with embedded numbers or names; the regex is matched against the whole whitespace-collapsed text, $1 inserts a group as is and {1} inserts it translated), overrides (wins over the game locale when a game term must read differently in the UI). Keys are exact English text; whitespace is collapsed before lookup and a trailing plural s is tried automatically. Game names (units, buildings, technologies, civilizations, ages, resources) come from data/i18n-zh-game.json, built from the game's official locale by scripts/build_zh_locale.py; do not repeat them here. Terms: Build 开局, Build order 建造顺序, Path 路线, Match 比赛, Games 对局, Library 资料库, Patch 版本, Metric 指标, Snapshot 快照, Theoretical 理论, Recorded 记录, Reference build 参考开局, Draft 草稿.
